info.title: ClassMarker Universal API
info.description: Online testing and quiz platform for retrieving exam results, managing access lists, and maintaining question banks and categories.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

accessCodes[].description: Access codes to add to the access list. ClassMarker allows up to 100 codes per request.
